findings.title: Team admin/owner check uses AND instead of OR
findings.body: isTeamAdminOrOwner requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner. A team admin who is not the owner, or an owner who fails the admin check, is rejected. The two checks should be combined with `||`.

findings.title: Any attendee can add arbitrary guests and trigger emails
findings.body: Any authenticated user whose email matches an attendee can add unlimited new guests. Each addition sends emails from the organizer's name to arbitrary addresses and adds them to the organizer's calendar event. The guest list size is also unbounded, so this can be abused for spam.

findings.title: Blacklist and duplicate checks are case-sensitive
findings.body: Blacklisted emails are lowercased but guest emails are not. Mixed-case input therefore bypasses the blacklist. The comparison against existing attendees is also case-sensitive, so the same email in different case is added again as a duplicate attendee.

findings.title: Emails sent based on the unfiltered guests list
findings.body: sendAddGuestsEmails is passed the raw `guests` input instead of `uniqueGuests`. If a submitted email already belonged to an existing attendee, that attendee receives a full 'scheduled' email instead of the 'guests added' update. The same applies to filtered (blacklisted or duplicate) entries.

findings.title: Calendar update uses the caller's credentials, not the organizer's
findings.body: The EventManager is built from ctx.user's credentials. When the caller is an attendee or a team admin, the organizer's calendar event is not updated with their credentials and the update fails or is skipped. The call is also not wrapped in error handling, so the mutation errors after the DB write has already committed.

findings.title: Guest added despite disabled host/attendee email settings
findings.body: sendAddGuestsEmails ignores the eventType metadata flags disableStandardEmails, unlike the other booking email senders, so these emails are sent even when standard emails are disabled.

findings.title: Fallback error message is unreachable
findings.body: `message` is a template string, so it is always truthy and the `unable_to_add_guests` fallback is never used. When `err.data?.code` is missing, users see 'undefined: ...'.

findings.title: Invalid-email error never clears
findings.body: isInvalidEmail is set to true on a failed validation but is never reset on a later successful validation or on a successful submit. The error stays visible until the dialog is cancelled.
